source.prompt: ERP solution for jewellery business with retail POS

answer.text:
Shared0 files
Implementing an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solution with an integrated retail Point of Sale (POS) for a jewelry business requires specialized features. Unlike standard retail, the jewelry industry deals with fluctuating precious metal and gem market rates, precise weight measurements, high-security inventory, custom manufacturing, and complex repair or layaway workflows.
Essential Features to Look For
Dynamic Metal & Stone Pricing:: Real-time or daily updates for gold, platinum, and silver rates linked directly to the POS billing engine.
Granular Inventory Tracking:: Support for unique serial numbers, RFID/barcoding, karat weights, stone specifications (cut, color, clarity, carat), and certificate tracking (GIA, AGS).
Advanced Retail POS:: Multi-tender payments (split cash, credit, gift cards), layaways, trade-ins, custom repair intake, and customer preference wishlists.
Manufacturing & Supply Chain:: Bill of Materials (BOM) for custom jewelry design, job work tracking (sending metal to karats/artisans and tracking loss/recovery), and vendor management.
Omnichannel Synchronization:: Seamless connection between physical storefronts and e-commerce platforms (like Shopify or custom web stores) so stock counts update instantly.
Top ERP & Integrated Retail POS Solutions for Jewelers
Shopify POS + Advanced ERP Connector: Best if your strategy relies heavily on an online storefront paired with physical retail. While Shopify is e-commerce-first, pairing it with robust back-office inventory or an industry-specific connector manages multi-channel synchronization well.
